## Unlock what matters most.

From unstructured data to unseen value, we help you protect, connect, and activate information to
tackle your most critical business challenges.
[backside of IM worker unpacking truck]
[old media film wrapped like a wheel]
[portrait of IM worker with files]

### Inventory management and logistics

Go from information to intelligence with our global inventory management and logistics services.
From records management to media services to fine art and consumer storage, discover why we’ve been
a trusted partner since 1951.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Records and document storage][274]|[Smart records cleanup suite][275]|[Iron Mountain Warehousing
and Logistics][276]|[Media and entertainment services][277]
[Learn more][278]
[close up of wires in IM data center in arizona]
[Data Centers employee on a tablet]
[Data Centers Phoenix AZP-2 colocation]

### Data center solutions

Protect, connect, and activate your data with our global infrastructure solutions. With 30+ data
centers across 3 continents, explore how you can expand your footprint and join our 1,300+ customers
around the world, including highly regulated organizations & leading global hyperscalers.

**Featured services and solutions:**
[Data centers][279]|[Data centers locations][280]
[Learn more][281]
[an employee working on server in dark, illuminated by laptop light]
[two business people walking outside office building]
[pointing to ai]

### Digital platform and solutions

Don’t just mine your data, manage it. Recognized as a top-20 BPS provider, we combine trusted
information governance with Iron Mountain InSight® DXP, delivering AI-powered insights and workflow
automation across digital and physical content, trusted in 125 countries.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Iron Mountain InSight DXP][282]|[InSight content management][283]|[Information governance advisory
services][284]|[InSight intelligent document processing][285]
[Learn more][286]
[it equipment]
[IM worker packaging IT assets for destruction closeup]
[closeup of IM worker disassembling IT assets]

### IT asset lifecycle management

We’re here to protect your data, drive IT efficiencies, and maximize the return on your IT hardware
investment. As the number one provider of ITAD in North America, we offer end-to-end services, from
deployment to disposition. Explore how we unlock value with a focus on IT reuse.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM)][287]|[Data center decommissioning][288]|[IT asset disposition
(ITAD) ][289]
[Learn more][290]

## Every lap tells a story

The McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team knows that progress isn’t about looking back—it’s about
powering what comes next. We’re proud to partner with McLaren to help make heritage assets
accessible, connecting fans and partners to the stories that shaped the sport.

[Heritage fuels innovation][291]

### Financial services

Digitize your banking and insurance operations.
[Learn More][292]
We work with 46 of the top 50 US banks.
[a healthcare professional in scrubs looking at colleague]

### Healthcare

Reduce complexity, elevate health data access and security, and accelerate digital transformation in
today’s complex healthcare environment.
[Learn More][293]
Our vintage equipment reads 99% of all formats.

### Entertainment and media archives

Keep your assets safe with physical archive storage, asset care, and more.
[Learn More][294]
[library and archives, interior of a modern library]

### Library and archival services

Explore innovative solutions for managing your unique collection.
[Learn More][295]

### Fine arts

State-of-the-art storage facilities for top-notch art preservation.
[Visit Crozier Website][296]
[Crozier employees filling storage container]
220 US agencies are serviced by our public sector team.

### Public sector

Securely store assets and accelerate your digital transformation.
[Learn More][297]

### Small businesses

Enhance operational efficiency, improve customer service, prevent data loss and security breaches
for your business.
[Learn More][298]
80,000 small businesses rely on us for transformation.
[two energy workers pointing at windmills during sunset]

### Energy: oil and gas

By unlocking the power of information, energy companies can accelerate innovation, boost
sustainability, and reduce expenditures.
[Learn More][299]

### AI Is Moving Into Everyday Work. Is Your Governance Ready?

Understand how AI regulation, Shadow AI, and AI-generated records are changing the way organizations
manage information, compliance, and risk.

AI rarely enters an organization through one door. It shows up in draft policies, meeting notes,
customer summaries, uploaded files, and decisions made with help from tools your teams may already
be using.

Over time, those prompts, outputs, logs, and AI-assisted decisions can contain sensitive information
or become records that need to be retained, protected, and managed. The challenge is knowing where
that risk appears, who owns it, and how to bring AI use into your broader information governance
strategy.

**In this eBook, you’ll learn:**
* How global AI regulation is developing across the EU

across your organization.

## Frequently Asked Questions


About Us

**Alignable is the networking platform for businesses.**

We’re rewriting the rules of networking by creating genuine opportunities and encouraging meaningful
relationships. That way, business owners can grow a network of trusted, authentic connections,
without the sales pitches and small talk.

**What to expect**

Networking looks different here, thanks to quality events, smart introductions, and our authentic
community of business owners.

Whether you want to meet genuine people to do business with, or to connect with like-minded people
for advice or support, we’ll help make it happen.

**Who we are**

Alignable was founded with a clear mission: to empower businesses by creating a vibrant, supportive,
and interconnected business ecosystem across North America. We understand the challenges and
opportunities that businesses face, and since 2014 our team has been dedicated to providing the
tools and resources needed to overcome these challenges and succeed.

What makes Alignable different from other social media platforms?

Alignable is not your average social media. In fact, we don’t consider it one. Alignable is the only
professional space where business owners can connect with other entrepreneurs at a local level. We
have put policies in place to keep our members' conversations productive and professional-
intentionally geared to drive value for our members. Say goodbye to spam and solicitation and say
hello to Alignable!

What's included in the Member plan?

The Member plan unlocks the tools that help you actively grow. More visibility, more ways to connect
with the right people, and the ability to establish yourself as a go-to expert in your community.

**Find your ideal customers**
* See unlimited 360° insights into your extended network so you know exactly who's already connected
  to you
* Get notified when someone views your profile
* Your posts get boosted visibility across discussion groups and events, so the right people see you
  first

**Build your referral network**
* Introduce yourself to potential partners each month using your included connection credits
* Smart Connect surfaces the business owners most relevant to you, so you're not starting from
  scratch
* See who's registered for in-person events before you show up

What makes Alignable valuable for my business?

The opportunities are endless! Alignable directly connects you with local business owners in a way
that no other platform can. By using these connections, you can spark conversations and find value
through the relationships you form. If networking isn’t all that you’re looking for, we have endless
discussions and learning opportunities to fine tune your business. We help you stick to what you’re
good at, while empowering you with resources and support to succeed at the rest.

## Dajon Industries

Every business is unique and faces challenges depending on its competing industry. That’s why your
organisation’s journey to the digital world should be customised according to your company’s needs
and goals. That’s where we come in. As a digital transformation management company, we have a wealth
of experience working across several sectors.
* Accounting and Finance
* Property Management
* Human Resources
* Insurance
* Legal
* Across Organisation

### Accounting and Finance

Your accounting department is one of your organisation’s most document and data-rich environments.
Without efficient processes in place, it can also become one of the most costly departments, in
time, money and resources.

From invoice and purchase order processing to data entry, reduce risk and regain full control of
your accounting processes with AP Automation. By managing the way work gets done, AP Automation
enables information to be error-free, digitised, findable and readily available, therefore freeing
up your accounting team to focus on their key deliverables and improve service levels.

With AP Automation all processes are centrally managed, allowing you to easily adapt the way you
work to address threats or opportunities without any additional training or dependency on internal
IT. No matter how many invoices your organisation handles, Dajon can help you to reduce the time
your processes take, reduce costs and ultimately support you in the growth of your business.

### Property Management

Processing the paperwork that goes with managing properties can be a time-consuming headache.
Invoice handling, lease, safety certificates and other essential document management can become a
full-time job. Yet with the right automated technology and processes, it needn’t be.

Automate data entry and streamline your processes so invoices can be routed to the right member of
your team at the right time, every time. Reduce errors, digitise your paperwork and ensure all your
documents are retrievable instantly by any member of your team.

Get more done in less time. Our business process specialists will work with you to automate your
business processes, saving you time and money and freeing your staff up for more productive tasks.
Our easy-to-use cloud-based software is accessible on any device anytime, taking the stress out of
property management.

### Human Resources

Handling all the human resources processes for your company is no easy task. Managing recruitment,
onboarding, performance, pay, pensions and learning and development – to name but a few – creates
significant challenges for HR departments. As your organisation grows, standardising and codifying
your processes can make it much easier to manage. With the right technology, you can get more done,
more efficiently, leaving your staff free to focus on high-value activities – not just handling
paperwork.

Automate repetitive HR processes like recruitment and onboarding. Have all your data in one place
and enable your organisation to share information across departments with ease.

A new starter request could trigger automated processes both in HR and across the organisation,
ensuring everyone is informed and the onboarding goes as smoothly as possible, without the need for
sending dozens of emails.

Automated workflows make it easier for people to do what is needed – for example, setting up their
pay details or pension online – and ensure management has control and visibility of important tasks
in real-time, wherever they are and on any device they like.

### Insurance

Managing all the paperwork which comes with an insurance business can be a labour-intensive task.
From handling quotes and no-claims discounts to managing claims and renewals, efficient and
organised systems and processes can make all the difference.

With the right software, you can handle your paperwork with ease with everything instantly available
at the click of a button. Our smart routing technology enables each member of your team to get more
done in less time. All of which means you can serve your customers better

Automate repetitive processes like renewals and underwriting. Share information with ease across
your organisation. Centrally held data with intelligent processes which are designed around your
business will make your job more rewarding and improve customer experience.

Automated workflows make life simpler for your staff, people have access to the relevant documents
they need to process paperwork. Workflows allow you to determine how you want work to be done and by
whom. All the time allows for flexibility. Busy companies need to reallocate resources to cover
holidays, peak business seasons, etc. Dajon’s insurance software makes life easier for your staff
and gives greater visibility, transparency and control for management.

### Legal

Ensuring a focus on billable hours will help you achieve your objectives. Do you have the workflows
in place to help your fee earners deliver and focus on client work?

Our document management systems will help you transition to smoother processes, allowing you to get
more done and enabling your team to focus where they make a difference – serving your clients
better. Whether you simply want to organise your paper flow or move to a fully automated paperless
office, we can help you transition smoothly and seamlessly, providing a better experience for your
clients and your staff.

### Across Organisation

One system which hosts all your business processes across your entire organisation makes it easier
to share data, to help your employees make decisions based on accurate and timely information. Total
flexibility and the control you need. With Dajon you can scale up as it suits you, confident you
will have a robust and compatible solution to benefit your business and your customers.

Business flows better when we all share the same system and data. Staff have access to accurate
information and this gives them the confidence to do their jobs well, customer questions are
answered quickly.

Leading organisations look to developments in IT as a competitive advantage and use them to work
better and provide a smoother service to their customers. Learn how you could benefit too.

Get in Touch with Experienced Digitisation Leaders

Ready to start your digital transformation journey? Contact Dajon today for a free no-obligation
consultation!

## Dajon Industries

Every business is unique and faces challenges depending on its competing industry. That’s why your
organisation’s journey to the digital world should be customised according to your company’s needs
and goals. That’s where we come in. As a digital transformation management company, we have a wealth
of experience working across several sectors.
* Accounting and Finance
* Property Management
* Human Resources
* Insurance
* Legal
* Across Organisation

### Accounting and Finance

Your accounting department is one of your organisation’s most document and data-rich environments.
Without efficient processes in place, it can also become one of the most costly departments, in
time, money and resources.

From invoice and purchase order processing to data entry, reduce risk and regain full control of
your accounting processes with AP Automation. By managing the way work gets done, AP Automation
enables information to be error-free, digitised, findable and readily available, therefore freeing
up your accounting team to focus on their key deliverables and improve service levels.

With AP Automation all processes are centrally managed, allowing you to easily adapt the way you
work to address threats or opportunities without any additional training or dependency on internal
IT. No matter how many invoices your organisation handles, Dajon can help you to reduce the time
your processes take, reduce costs and ultimately support you in the growth of your business.

### Property Management

Processing the paperwork that goes with managing properties can be a time-consuming headache.
Invoice handling, lease, safety certificates and other essential document management can become a
full-time job. Yet with the right automated technology and processes, it needn’t be.

Automate data entry and streamline your processes so invoices can be routed to the right member of
your team at the right time, every time. Reduce errors, digitise your paperwork and ensure all your
documents are retrievable instantly by any member of your team.

Get more done in less time. Our business process specialists will work with you to automate your
business processes, saving you time and money and freeing your staff up for more productive tasks.
Our easy-to-use cloud-based software is accessible on any device anytime, taking the stress out of
property management.

### Human Resources

Handling all the human resources processes for your company is no easy task. Managing recruitment,
onboarding, performance, pay, pensions and learning and development – to name but a few – creates
significant challenges for HR departments. As your organisation grows, standardising and codifying
your processes can make it much easier to manage. With the right technology, you can get more done,
more efficiently, leaving your staff free to focus on high-value activities – not just handling
paperwork.

Automate repetitive HR processes like recruitment and onboarding. Have all your data in one place
and enable your organisation to share information across departments with ease.

A new starter request could trigger automated processes both in HR and across the organisation,
ensuring everyone is informed and the onboarding goes as smoothly as possible, without the need for
sending dozens of emails.

Automated workflows make it easier for people to do what is needed – for example, setting up their
pay details or pension online – and ensure management has control and visibility of important tasks
in real-time, wherever they are and on any device they like.

### Insurance

Managing all the paperwork which comes with an insurance business can be a labour-intensive task.
From handling quotes and no-claims discounts to managing claims and renewals, efficient and
organised systems and processes can make all the difference.

With the right software, you can handle your paperwork with ease with everything instantly available
at the click of a button. Our smart routing technology enables each member of your team to get more
done in less time. All of which means you can serve your customers better

Automate repetitive processes like renewals and underwriting. Share information with ease across
your organisation. Centrally held data with intelligent processes which are designed around your
business will make your job more rewarding and improve customer experience.

Automated workflows make life simpler for your staff, people have access to the relevant documents
they need to process paperwork. Workflows allow you to determine how you want work to be done and by
whom. All the time allows for flexibility. Busy companies need to reallocate resources to cover
holidays, peak business seasons, etc. Dajon’s insurance software makes life easier for your staff
and gives greater visibility, transparency and control for management.

### Legal

Ensuring a focus on billable hours will help you achieve your objectives. Do you have the workflows
in place to help your fee earners deliver and focus on client work?

Our document management systems will help you transition to smoother processes, allowing you to get
more done and enabling your team to focus where they make a difference – serving your clients
better. Whether you simply want to organise your paper flow or move to a fully automated paperless
office, we can help you transition smoothly and seamlessly, providing a better experience for your
clients and your staff.

### Across Organisation

One system which hosts all your business processes across your entire organisation makes it easier
to share data, to help your employees make decisions based on accurate and timely information. Total
flexibility and the control you need. With Dajon you can scale up as it suits you, confident you
will have a robust and compatible solution to benefit your business and your customers.

Business flows better when we all share the same system and data. Staff have access to accurate
information and this gives them the confidence to do their jobs well, customer questions are
answered quickly.

Leading organisations look to developments in IT as a competitive advantage and use them to work
better and provide a smoother service to their customers. Learn how you could benefit too.

# **Digital Conversion Services**

A digitizing company founded in 2007, DiJiFi helps clients across the globe digitize movies, film,
photos, and more. Our digital conversion services convert all forms of old media (photos, slides,
film, audio, videos, paper documents, books, microfilm, microfiche, etc.) into digital files,
allowing for convenient storage and the preservation of your cherished memories and important
documents. Over the course of 17 years, we have used our document, movie, photo, and film digitizing
services to transfer over 11,500,000 feet of film, over 8,500,000 photos, and over 1,500,000 hours
of video and audio recordings for clients small and large.

[ Get to know more about our company ][40]

### Check out some of our digitizing services below.

## Photo Services

### DiJiFi is recognized for our ability to provide high-quality media digitizing services for all
### photo formats and still images. We are capable of optimizing images in digital form, printing
### high-quality and archival images and saving your digital files to hard drives, discs or the
### cloud. We can also back up and add descriptive info to each image, which allows you to easily
### track and organize your images.

[ Learn more ][41]
 

> “DiJiFi was an amazing partner in preserving our memories in a professional and cost effective
> way. We are forever grateful for their integrity and customer service and follow through. They
> worked with us on pricing and completed the job exactly as they said they would. Thank you so
> much.”

— Rick Kaplan
 

## Transfer Services

### Old film lying around? VHS tapes? BetaMax? Vinyl you want on your computer finally? We digitize
### film of all kinds. DiJiFi provides film transfers for 16mm, 8mm, and Super 8 film, along with
### video transfers, audio transfers, and even data recovery and hard drive transfers. Let us
### digitize film for you to preserve your fondest recordings.

[ Learn more ][42]

> “Did a wonderful job transferring my parents 60 year old wedding film. 16mm silent. They knew the
> proper transfer rate, and corrected color properly. Highest recommendation.”

— Tom T.

## Digitize Your Documents

### Whether it is a small job or a large one, let us digitize your paper documents. Reduce the paper
### and clutter in your office, increase productivity and cut costs quickly and easily. Our document
### scanning services allow you to access your digital files securely and easily on any computer,
### laptop or mobile device. As a digitizing company, our focus is on customer satisfaction. Our
### expert personnel provide the best document scanning services on the market.

[ Learn more ][43]
 

> “Excellent experience, work was done properly and in a timely manner, customer service was
> excellent.”

— Mark Segal
 

## Microfilm / Fiche

### At one point in time, microfilm and microfiche were state of the art media. That is no longer
### the case. Let our digital conversion services preserve your microform into digital files. We
### recognize that the prospect of converting your microfiche/film collections may seem like
### herculean tasks. Let us guide you through the process. What sets us apart from other digitizing
### service providers is our superior technology, our focus on customer service, and the effort we
### make to understand your project’s goals and deliver an exceptional experience.

[ Learn more ][44]

> “The folks at DiJiFi are courteous, helpful, and committed to an excellent job. My organization
> has worked with them on large-scale projects that span several months and smaller batches of work,
> and in all cases, they go above and beyond to do the job well, ensure we’re routinely informed of
> job progress, and satisfied customers. I highly recommend their services.”

— From Trustpilot

##  Let us help you preserve those memories.

### Get in touch for a free estimate on your digitization project.

# **Digital Conversion Services**

A digitizing company founded in 2007, DiJiFi helps clients across the globe digitize movies, film,
photos, and more. Our digital conversion services convert all forms of old media (photos, slides,
film, audio, videos, paper documents, books, microfilm, microfiche, etc.) into digital files,
allowing for convenient storage and the preservation of your cherished memories and important
documents. Over the course of 17 years, we have used our document, movie, photo, and film digitizing
services to transfer over 11,500,000 feet of film, over 8,500,000 photos, and over 1,500,000 hours
of video and audio recordings for clients small and large.

[ Get to know more about our company ][40]

### Check out some of our digitizing services below.

## Photo Services

### DiJiFi is recognized for our ability to provide high-quality media digitizing services for all
### photo formats and still images. We are capable of optimizing images in digital form, printing
### high-quality and archival images and saving your digital files to hard drives, discs or the
### cloud. We can also back up and add descriptive info to each image, which allows you to easily
### track and organize your images.

[ Learn more ][41]
 

> “DiJiFi was an amazing partner in preserving our memories in a professional and cost effective
> way. We are forever grateful for their integrity and customer service and follow through. They
> worked with us on pricing and completed the job exactly as they said they would. Thank you so
> much.”

— Rick Kaplan
 

## Transfer Services

### Old film lying around? VHS tapes? BetaMax? Vinyl you want on your computer finally? We digitize
### film of all kinds. DiJiFi provides film transfers for 16mm, 8mm, and Super 8 film, along with
### video transfers, audio transfers, and even data recovery and hard drive transfers. Let us
### digitize film for you to preserve your fondest recordings.

[ Learn more ][42]

> “Did a wonderful job transferring my parents 60 year old wedding film. 16mm silent. They knew the
> proper transfer rate, and corrected color properly. Highest recommendation.”

— Tom T.

## Digitize Your Documents

### Whether it is a small job or a large one, let us digitize your paper documents. Reduce the paper
### and clutter in your office, increase productivity and cut costs quickly and easily. Our document
### scanning services allow you to access your digital files securely and easily on any computer,
### laptop or mobile device. As a digitizing company, our focus is on customer satisfaction. Our
### expert personnel provide the best document scanning services on the market.

[ Learn more ][43]
 

> “Excellent experience, work was done properly and in a timely manner, customer service was
> excellent.”

— Mark Segal
 

## Microfilm / Fiche

### At one point in time, microfilm and microfiche were state of the art media. That is no longer
### the case. Let our digital conversion services preserve your microform into digital files. We
### recognize that the prospect of converting your microfiche/film collections may seem like
### herculean tasks. Let us guide you through the process. What sets us apart from other digitizing
### service providers is our superior technology, our focus on customer service, and the effort we
### make to understand your project’s goals and deliver an exceptional experience.

[ Learn more ][44]

> “The folks at DiJiFi are courteous, helpful, and committed to an excellent job. My organization
> has worked with them on large-scale projects that span several months and smaller batches of work,
> and in all cases, they go above and beyond to do the job well, ensure we’re routinely informed of
> job progress, and satisfied customers. I highly recommend their services.”

— From Trustpilot

## Great Brands Trust ARC

## Frequently Asked Questions

Why should I choose ARC?

ARC’s creative team have vast experience creating innovative, eye-catching designs. Whether it’s
branding, marketing, print design, video animation, or artworking, ARC’s design team will be happy
to help with your requirements. Please check out our portfolio to see a selection of our previous
projects.

Do you work with clients all over the world?

Yes – ARC’s AE studio work with global, national and local clients, providing each with the same
high standard of design work.

What kind of work do you do?

Our creative studio has vast experience in all areas of design from creation of new visual
identities, creating new designs while adhering to strict brand guidelines, through to small and
large format print design, environmental graphics and digital graphics. Please get in touch to find
out more.

Can you help me source images for my project?

Yes – ARC can help with sourcing high quality images, or even help commission a professional
photographer if required.

How much will it cost?

We are happy to provide an estimate in advance of starting any project work, please get in touch to
discuss your requirements.

How do I Get a Quote?

Please call us on [+971501983007][44] or email [info.uae@e-arc.com][45]

How Much Does Paper Scanning Cost?

ARC has flexible options from cost per scan to fixed cost per box.

What Kind of Prep Work Is Needed for The Scanning Project?

ARC experienced staff will remove all fixings and staples to allow automatic scanning.

Do you provide box storage and scan and retrieve?

ARC has a full records management solution for box storage to scan on demand.

How do I search for documents or text within the scanned document?

ARC can index the documents to allow fast retrieval and text searching on key words.

Which File Format Should I Choose for My Documents?

PDF (Portable Document Format) are the most widely used formats for scanned images. ARC scanning
solutions can convert your paper records to TIFF, PDF or a variety of other file formats for
seamless integration with your document management application or enterprise content management
(ECM) system.

Do you provide search and retrieval of scanned documents?

ARC can provide an archival document management solution hosted in the UK, allowing you to search
and view your documents on your mobile devise or PC or MAC.

Do you provide BIM outsourcing services?

ARC has a comprehensive range of services including Rendering, BIM Clash Detection Revit modelling,
3D modelling.

Can you attend meetings?

ARC has consultants experienced in BIM to attend site meetings remotely or in person.

Can you provide Revit libraries?

ARC is experienced in provide Revit modelling.

Do you provide 3D modelling?

ARC can provide 3D Modelling service for architects and engineering companies, but also point of
sale items.

Do you provide document management cloud solutions?

ARC has a range of document management collaboration solutions for architectural, engineering and
construction.

Does you solution work on all platforms?

ARC solution is cross platform allowing PC, MAC, and mobile applications to be used.

Can you provide inbound scanning of mail?

ARC can provide redirect using POBOXES to allow post to be redirected to our inbound mail scanning
team, for distributed to your email boxes.

Can you provide outbound mail service via POBOX redirect?

ARC can provide a full workflow from allowing the user access to our Click 2 Post software, allowing
the user to send files direct to ARC for printing and posting.

What file format do you need?

The Portable Document Format (PDF) is generally the preferred file format for submitting a document
for printing as it works with virtually all professional printing and digital output devices. By
design, a PDF file incorporates the information needed to maintain document consistency from system
to system. Most other file formats such as Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Microsoft Word are easily
converted to PDF format.

What are crop/trim marks?

Crop marks help indicate where the product will be cut to its finished size.

What is bleed?

Bleed is required to ensure edge-to-edge colour on your final product. Any background colours or
images need to expand your final size by 3mm on all sides to allow for any movement on the
guillotine.

RGB or CMYK?

We print in CMYK (cyan, magenta, yellow, black). Ensure your colour is set to this as RGB and
Pantone artworks will be automatically converted which could slightly affect final print.

Which binding options do you offer?

**Perfect Binding:**

Gluing the outside edges of the paper together to create a flat edge then a wrap around cover
applied.

**Saddle-stitch binding (Fold stitch and trim).**

Using staples along the folds of the pages to bind them together. Pages need to be multiples of 4.

**Wire binding:**

Wires in a spiral form are threated through holes along the binging edge. Allows the document to lay
flat when open. (Silver/White/Black all stocked).

**Plastic Comb binding:**

Similar to Wire binding but using tubular plastic piece which fits through rectangular holes punched
into binding edge.

**Ring Binders:**

Holes are punched into pages and inserted into ring binder.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Why should I choose ARC?

ARC’s creative team have vast experience creating innovative, eye-catching designs. Whether it’s
branding, marketing, print design, video animation, or artworking, ARC’s design team will be happy
to help with your requirements. Please check out our portfolio to see a selection of our previous
projects.

Do you work with clients all over the world?

Yes – ARC’s AE studio work with global, national and local clients, providing each with the same
high standard of design work.

What kind of work do you do?

Our creative studio has vast experience in all areas of design from creation of new visual
identities, creating new designs while adhering to strict brand guidelines, through to small and
large format print design, environmental graphics and digital graphics. Please get in touch to find
out more.

Can you help me source images for my project?

Yes – ARC can help with sourcing high quality images, or even help commission a professional
photographer if required.

How much will it cost?

We are happy to provide an estimate in advance of starting any project work, please get in touch to
discuss your requirements.

How do I Get a Quote?

Please call us on [+971501983007][44] or email [info.uae@e-arc.com][45]

How Much Does Paper Scanning Cost?

ARC has flexible options from cost per scan to fixed cost per box.

What Kind of Prep Work Is Needed for The Scanning Project?

ARC experienced staff will remove all fixings and staples to allow automatic scanning.

Do you provide box storage and scan and retrieve?

ARC has a full records management solution for box storage to scan on demand.

How do I search for documents or text within the scanned document?

ARC can index the documents to allow fast retrieval and text searching on key words.

Which File Format Should I Choose for My Documents?

PDF (Portable Document Format) are the most widely used formats for scanned images. ARC scanning
solutions can convert your paper records to TIFF, PDF or a variety of other file formats for
seamless integration with your document management application or enterprise content management
(ECM) system.

Do you provide search and retrieval of scanned documents?

ARC can provide an archival document management solution hosted in the UK, allowing you to search
and view your documents on your mobile devise or PC or MAC.

Do you provide BIM outsourcing services?

ARC has a comprehensive range of services including Rendering, BIM Clash Detection Revit modelling,
3D modelling.

Can you attend meetings?

ARC has consultants experienced in BIM to attend site meetings remotely or in person.

Can you provide Revit libraries?

ARC is experienced in provide Revit modelling.

Do you provide 3D modelling?

ARC can provide 3D Modelling service for architects and engineering companies, but also point of
sale items.

Do you provide document management cloud solutions?

ARC has a range of document management collaboration solutions for architectural, engineering and
construction.

Does you solution work on all platforms?

ARC solution is cross platform allowing PC, MAC, and mobile applications to be used.

Can you provide inbound scanning of mail?

ARC can provide redirect using POBOXES to allow post to be redirected to our inbound mail scanning
team, for distributed to your email boxes.

Can you provide outbound mail service via POBOX redirect?

ARC can provide a full workflow from allowing the user access to our Click 2 Post software, allowing
the user to send files direct to ARC for printing and posting.

What file format do you need?

The Portable Document Format (PDF) is generally the preferred file format for submitting a document
for printing as it works with virtually all professional printing and digital output devices. By
design, a PDF file incorporates the information needed to maintain document consistency from system
to system. Most other file formats such as Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Microsoft Word are easily
converted to PDF format.

What are crop/trim marks?

Crop marks help indicate where the product will be cut to its finished size.

What is bleed?

Bleed is required to ensure edge-to-edge colour on your final product. Any background colours or
images need to expand your final size by 3mm on all sides to allow for any movement on the
guillotine.

RGB or CMYK?

We print in CMYK (cyan, magenta, yellow, black). Ensure your colour is set to this as RGB and
Pantone artworks will be automatically converted which could slightly affect final print.

Which binding options do you offer?

**Perfect Binding:**

Gluing the outside edges of the paper together to create a flat edge then a wrap around cover
applied.

**Saddle-stitch binding (Fold stitch and trim).**

Using staples along the folds of the pages to bind them together. Pages need to be multiples of 4.

**Wire binding:**

Wires in a spiral form are threated through holes along the binging edge. Allows the document to lay
flat when open. (Silver/White/Black all stocked).

**Plastic Comb binding:**

Similar to Wire binding but using tubular plastic piece which fits through rectangular holes punched
into binding edge.

**Ring Binders:**

Holes are punched into pages and inserted into ring binder.

## Production Printing

Outsourcing printing and design for marketing can be expensive, slow and leaves you with little
control. Taking control of your marketing and design with a **Production Print System** will save
you money, time, and most importantly, allow your marketing team to do things the way they want,
when they want it. 

We provide Ricoh’s best-in-market technology. Making marketing pieces, signs, business cards,
envelopes, posters, packaging and almost anything else can be at your finger tips.
* Print at a fraction of the cost of an outsourced print service
* Large or small runs at the touch of your fingertips!
* Neon colors and clear coat layers – go beyond CMYK
* Keep jobs moving full speed ahead
* Greater productivity

[eRecordsUSA][131] efficiently handles large-volume scans with top-tier quality, performed entirely

We provide [Document Imaging][132] services tailored to San Francisco businesses, saving them time,

## Our Document Scanning Process

### Digital Document Conversion

Our Digital Document Conversion Process streamlines the transition of physical documents into
secure, accessible digital formats. We start by assessing each document type, from contracts to
architectural blueprints, ensuring they meet industry standards. After scanning, each file undergoes
quality checks aligned with HIPAA and GDPR compliance, enhancing both security and operational
efficiency.

### Document Scanning Requirements:

At this stage, we define your organization’s specific project requirements, which guide our tailored
solution for converting your files into digital assets. As part of our service, we offer sample
processing for your review and feedback.

### Document Pick Up & Receipt:

Our secure vehicles and permanent employees handle all pickups—no third-party carriers involved.
Documents arrive at our secure facility, are received in a monitored area, and checked for damage.
Each box is logged and secured to ensure a safe and traceable process.

### Document Inventory:

Upon receiving project files, we inventory and label each box, allowing quick retrieval if needed.
This careful tracking minimizes disruption to your operations.

### Document Preparation:

Before scanning, we prepare your files by removing staples, repairing pages, and ensuring optimal
page orientation. Our team focuses on both general requirements and any specific needs, such as
handling Post-It Notes or color images, to ensure the files are scan-ready while preserving document
integrity.

### Project Setup:

We customize technical requirements for each project, defining the specific processes and quality
standards to follow during your document imaging project.

### File Conversion:

Our scanning team converts physical files into digital formats like PDFs, focusing on image
settings, file format, and page size. We monitor quality continuously, with a Scanning Services
Quality Lead performing a full review to ensure that all imaging requirements are met.

### Post-conversion Services:

Once converted, files are enhanced as needed and OCR-processed for searchable text, allowing
word-level search and retrieval within the documents.

### File Naming, Coding & Quality Review:

Files are named, indexed, and coded for easy search and retrieval. OCR enables secure word-level
searches. We focus on accuracy in naming, coding, and validation.

### Project Deliverable & Quality Assurance:

We store your digital files on a secure FTP or hosted solution and prepare a Project Status Report.
Each stage of the conversion process is designed to ensure quality and consistency.

### File Return or Certified Destruction:

Once you receive your digital files, we offer options to return, recycle, or securely destroy the
original documents. We can initiate electronic file destruction to permanently delete files upon
request.

### Document Retrieval Services:

Throughout the project, a dedicated supervisor and customer service representative handle all file
retrieval requests. We deliver files to authorized employees securely, either as password-protected
PDFs or through encrypted file-sharing systems.

**At eRecordsUSA, we specialize in document imaging and backfile conversion for a wide range of
document types::**
* **Industry-Specific Records**: Education records, [Federal Government records][135], [Financial
  records][136], Historical archives, Human Resources files, Insurance records, [Legal/ Litigation
  records][137], [Medical & Patient records][138], Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology documents,
  Publishing and Media records, State and Local Government files, Utility service records, Technical
  Manuals, and Ship Drawings.
* **Archival and Fragile Documents**: We digitize fragile and historical records, including Annual
  Reports, Board Minutes, Consumer Catalogs, Correspondence, Employee Newsletters, HR Files,
  Manuscripts, Maps and Drawings, Media Libraries, Microfilm, Microfiche, News Clippings, Photo
  Collections, Sales and Marketing Materials, Research Files, Trade Catalogs, and Art Collections.
* **[Book scanning][139]**: Lab notebooks, research books, scrapbooks, ledgers, deeds, technical
  manuals, textbooks, yearbooks, bound newspapers, sacramental registers, rare books, vital records,
  and more.
* **Visual Media**: Microfilm, aperture cards, slides, negatives, photo albums, and X-ray and NDT
  radiographic films.
* **[Large format document scanning][140]**: Engineering drawings, architectural plans,

  surveys, and more.

## Our Document Scanning Process

### Digital Document Conversion

Our Digital Document Conversion Process streamlines the transition of physical documents into
secure, accessible digital formats. We start by assessing each document type, from contracts to
architectural blueprints, ensuring they meet industry standards. After scanning, each file undergoes
quality checks aligned with HIPAA and GDPR compliance, enhancing both security and operational
efficiency.

### Document Scanning Requirements:

At this stage, we define your organization’s specific project requirements, which guide our tailored
solution for converting your files into digital assets. As part of our service, we offer sample
processing for your review and feedback.

### Document Pick Up & Receipt:

Our secure vehicles and permanent employees handle all pickups—no third-party carriers involved.
Documents arrive at our secure facility, are received in a monitored area, and checked for damage.
Each box is logged and secured to ensure a safe and traceable process.

### Document Inventory:

Upon receiving project files, we inventory and label each box, allowing quick retrieval if needed.
This careful tracking minimizes disruption to your operations.

### Document Preparation:

Before scanning, we prepare your files by removing staples, repairing pages, and ensuring optimal
page orientation. Our team focuses on both general requirements and any specific needs, such as
handling Post-It Notes or color images, to ensure the files are scan-ready while preserving document
integrity.

### Project Setup:

We customize technical requirements for each project, defining the specific processes and quality
standards to follow during your document imaging project.

### File Conversion:

Our scanning team converts physical files into digital formats like PDFs, focusing on image
settings, file format, and page size. We monitor quality continuously, with a Scanning Services
Quality Lead performing a full review to ensure that all imaging requirements are met.

### Post-conversion Services:

Once converted, files are enhanced as needed and OCR-processed for searchable text, allowing
word-level search and retrieval within the documents.

### File Naming, Coding & Quality Review:

Files are named, indexed, and coded for easy search and retrieval. OCR enables secure word-level
searches. We focus on accuracy in naming, coding, and validation.

### Project Deliverable & Quality Assurance:

We store your digital files on a secure FTP or hosted solution and prepare a Project Status Report.
Each stage of the conversion process is designed to ensure quality and consistency.

### File Return or Certified Destruction:

Once you receive your digital files, we offer options to return, recycle, or securely destroy the
original documents. We can initiate electronic file destruction to permanently delete files upon
request.

### Document Retrieval Services:

Throughout the project, a dedicated supervisor and customer service representative handle all file
retrieval requests. We deliver files to authorized employees securely, either as password-protected
PDFs or through encrypted file-sharing systems.

  This secures your data by converting it into a code that only authorized users can decipher,

  even more control over who can reach your documents — and from where.

* Custom password policy
  Administrators can enforce custom password policies by defining rules for length, complexity, and
  expiration. Additionally, they can mandate the use of two-factor authentication to enhance
  security.

  This ensures your data is redundantly stored across multiple locations, at least 100 km apart, for
  maximum safety and reliability. Even in the unlikely event of a failure at one site, your data
  remains secure and accessible.
  s Triple Backups

  This ensures that even if a user with delete permissions removes a file, it can still be reviewed

  Review completed, pending, and sent workflows together with participant decisions, comments,

  s Workflow history & summaries

### Logistics Warehouse Equipment

With the improvement of living standards, logistics and transportation occupy an increasingly
important position in social and economic development. However, logistics companies still have many
problems, such as: management processes are not smooth, information transmission is not in place,
transportation resources are scattered, fleet management is inefficient, etc. This extensive
business model leads to low operational efficiency, high costs, and low profits in the logistics
industry, transportation capacity is scattered, service quality is poor, and development is slow.
In view of the current situation where the number of express delivery items is huge, space is
limited, labor efficiency has reached a bottleneck, and the transfer efficiency cannot be improved
by adding labor, it has become a reality for automated logistics transfer to replace intensive
manual operations. Become the inevitable choice for the world's logistics companies. Automated
logistics transfer solutions can provide express logistics companies with accurate billing basis,
real-time sorting information, reasonable vehicle management and long-term historical data. As the
core system in the express delivery stage, it operates stably and efficiently, with accurate and
timely data, providing basic information for express sorting, cost settlement, logistics
traceability, etc.

### Packing Machine

As a leading enterprise in the packaging machinery industry, Gosunm leverages two decades of
dedicated R&D experience to deliver intelligent packaging solutions to over 2,000 enterprises across
more than 30 countries. Backed by an international team of 200 skilled professionals and over 80
patented technologies, we offer industry-leading capabilities with high-speed output ranging from
200 to 1,000 units per minute and ultra-precise packaging accuracy of ±0.2mm.
We provide comprehensive packaging solutions for a wide range of sectors including food,
pharmaceuticals, personal care, electronics, and logistics—covering the entire process from carton
sealing, wrapping, filling, labeling to palletizing.
Our independently developed servo control systems and AI-based vision inspection technology ensure
that our equipment maintains superior performance. Standard models can be delivered within 7 days,
and customized solutions are completed within 30 working days. Each major project is supported by a
dedicated team of engineers, following through from on-site evaluation to installation and
commissioning.
Whether you require aseptic packaging for the food and beverage industry, GMP-compliant systems for
pharmaceuticals, anti-static precision packaging for electronics, or smart sorting and packaging
lines for e-commerce logistics, our expert team will tailor the most optimized solution to meet your
needs.

### Kraft Paper Tape Sealing Machine

As a professional manufacturer of environmentally friendly packaging automation equipment, gosunm
focuses on the research and development and production of fully automatic water-activated kraft
paper tape machines, aiming to provide efficient, environmentally friendly, and reliable carton
opening and sealing solutions for the modern logistics and e-commerce industries.

important position in social and economic development. However, logistics companies still have many
problems, such as: management processes are not smooth, information transmission is not in place,
transportation resources are scattered, fleet management is inefficient, etc. This extensive
business model leads to low operational efficiency, high costs, and low profits in the logistics
industry, transportation capacity is scattered, service quality is poor, and development is slow.
In view of the current situation where the number of express delivery items is huge, space is
limited, labor efficiency has reached a bottleneck, and the transfer efficiency cannot be improved
by adding labor, it has become a reality for automated logistics transfer to replace intensive
manual operations. Become the inevitable choice for the world's logistics companies. Automated
logistics transfer solutions can provide express logistics companies with accurate billing basis,
real-time sorting information, reasonable vehicle management and long-term historical data. As the
core system in the express delivery stage, it operates stably and efficiently, with accurate and
timely data, providing basic information for express sorting, cost settlement, logistics
traceability, etc.

### Packing Machine

As a leading enterprise in the packaging machinery industry, Gosunm leverages two decades of
dedicated R&D experience to deliver intelligent packaging solutions to over 2,000 enterprises across
more than 30 countries. Backed by an international team of 200 skilled professionals and over 80
patented technologies, we offer industry-leading capabilities with high-speed output ranging from
200 to 1,000 units per minute and ultra-precise packaging accuracy of ±0.2mm.
We provide comprehensive packaging solutions for a wide range of sectors including food,
pharmaceuticals, personal care, electronics, and logistics—covering the entire process from carton
sealing, wrapping, filling, labeling to palletizing.
Our independently developed servo control systems and AI-based vision inspection technology ensure
that our equipment maintains superior performance. Standard models can be delivered within 7 days,
and customized solutions are completed within 30 working days. Each major project is supported by a
dedicated team of engineers, following through from on-site evaluation to installation and
commissioning.
Whether you require aseptic packaging for the food and beverage industry, GMP-compliant systems for
pharmaceuticals, anti-static precision packaging for electronics, or smart sorting and packaging
lines for e-commerce logistics, our expert team will tailor the most optimized solution to meet your
needs.

### Kraft Paper Tape Sealing Machine

As a professional manufacturer of environmentally friendly packaging automation equipment, gosunm
focuses on the research and development and production of fully automatic water-activated kraft
paper tape machines, aiming to provide efficient, environmentally friendly, and reliable carton
opening and sealing solutions for the modern logistics and e-commerce industries.
Our fully automatic water-activated tape machine is designed to replace traditional plastic tape

friendly packaging. The system integrates automatic tape feeding, wetting, cutting, and sealing
functions, ensuring consistent and high-quality carton sealing.
Our fully automatic kraft paper tape machines are widely used in e-commerce warehouses, logistics
distribution centers, and manufacturing facilities. Key advantages include high-speed operation,
strong sealing performance, reduced material waste, and user-friendly operation—helping businesses

## Frequently Ask Questions

###### How secure is my data during scanning?

We follow strict confidentiality protocols - only authorized personnel access documents, with
chain-of-custody tracking and secure storage.

###### What formats will I receive digitally?

PDF (searchable), TIFF, JPEG, Word, Excel - as per your preference.

###### Do you handle fragile or old books?

Yes - we use specialized book scanners and care processes to preserve fragile pages.

###### Can you provide on-site scanning at my premises?

Absolutely. For large volumes or sensitive documents, we can setup scanning onsite.

###### How do you price projects?

Pricing depends on volume, condition (old/fragile vs. modern), scanning resolution, extra services
like OCR, binding, etc. We’ll give you a detailed quote after assessing.

## Frequently Ask Questions

###### How secure is my data during scanning?

We follow strict confidentiality protocols - only authorized personnel access documents, with
chain-of-custody tracking and secure storage.

###### What formats will I receive digitally?

PDF (searchable), TIFF, JPEG, Word, Excel - as per your preference.

###### Do you handle fragile or old books?

Yes - we use specialized book scanners and care processes to preserve fragile pages.

###### Can you provide on-site scanning at my premises?

Absolutely. For large volumes or sensitive documents, we can setup scanning onsite.

###### How do you price projects?

Pricing depends on volume, condition (old/fragile vs. modern), scanning resolution, extra services
like OCR, binding, etc. We’ll give you a detailed quote after assessing.

Best Practices * With the help of InfoLogistics' docuForce solution, we have converted the cash records of the Prisma chain of stores into electronic form. We have significantly reduced our costs for this business process. * Our relationship with customers involves the need to provide detailed agency reports along with closing documents. To generate such reports for customers, you need to transfer a large volume of information from invoices from suppliers, most of which use paper documents. Outsourcing of digitization and data entry from documents from Infologistics has made it possible to significantly reduce labor costs for the process of forming agency acts and scale the process without increasing its own staff company. * To increase operational efficiency, we decided to adhere to the concept of centralized accounting, when there are no accountants in stores, and store managers sign documents from local suppliers. In this regard, the question of the speed of payment of bills arose sharply, since originals from remote stores were delivered to the central office for a long time, and there was no mechanism to control these deliveries. Infologistics has developed a mobile application for us that allows store employees to quickly take a photo of documents, send them to the Operations Center for recognition and verification, and from there - to payment approval systems. customer success, we bridge the gap between advanced digital solutions and practical business needs,

platform that simplifies complex IT infrastructures for land administration. With a comprehensive

system integration—providing the foundation for sustainable growth and innovation—from managing
traditional deed recordation processes to building interest-focused property registers.

## Liberty Scanning – Your Complete Records Management Solution

Liberty Scanning is a trusted full-service records management company, helping businesses, medical
providers, law firms, schools, and government agencies take control of their information through
secure, efficient solutions. Our services cover the entire document lifecycle, including
high-quality scanning, secure digital archiving, and HIPAA-compliant on-site and mobile shredding.
We convert paper archives into fully searchable digital files, streamline storage, reduce physical
clutter, and provide instant access through our Liberty Cloud platform.

Security and compliance are at the core of everything we do. Operating secure facilities,
maintaining ISO 9001:2015 certification, and holding an A+ BBB rating, we ensure sensitive
information is handled with the highest level of care and accountability. Whether you need one-time
scanning and shredding or ongoing records management support, Liberty Scanning customizes solutions
to meet your organization’s needs, making us the trusted partner for complete records management.

# Meaningful Connections Brand Consulting - Connecting Brands with Their Audiences

At Meaningful Connections Brand Consulting, we specialize in providing high-end consulting and
analytical services for businesses in the business and consumer services industry. Our expert team
is dedicated to helping brands establish a strong presence, connect meaningfully with their target
audience, and achieve sustainable growth.

## Unmatched Expertise in Business and Consumer Services

With years of experience in the industry, we have gained unmatched expertise in understanding the
unique dynamics of the business and consumer services sector. Our strategic approach, combined with
our comprehensive knowledge, enables us to provide tailor-made solutions that address the specific
challenges and opportunities faced by businesses in this industry.

## Strategic Consulting

Our strategic consulting services are designed to empower businesses to make informed decisions and
drive success. We work closely with our clients to assess their current position, identify growth
opportunities, and develop effective strategies to achieve their goals. Whether it's market
analysis, competitor research, or brand positioning, we have the expertise to guide businesses
towards success.

## Target Audience Analysis

We firmly believe that understanding the target audience is key to developing effective marketing
and branding strategies. Our team conducts in-depth target audience analysis to gain insights into
their preferences, behaviors, and needs. This information helps us create customized campaigns and
ensure that our clients' messages resonate with their audience on a deeper level.

## Brand Development and Positioning

Building a strong brand requires careful planning and execution. Our brand development and
positioning services are aimed at creating a unique brand identity that stands out in a competitive
market. From brand messaging to visual identity, we work closely with our clients to craft a
compelling story and create a brand that resonates with their target audience.

## Market Research and Analysis

Staying ahead of the competition requires constant monitoring of market trends and consumer
behavior. Our market research and analysis services provide businesses with valuable insights into
industry trends, customer preferences, and competitor strategies. Armed with this information, our
clients can make data-driven decisions that drive growth and maximize their competitive advantage.

## Comprehensive Analytical Solutions

We understand the importance of data in today's business landscape. Our analytical solutions help
businesses transform raw data into actionable insights. From data collection and analysis to
performance tracking and reporting, we provide comprehensive analytical services that empower
businesses to make informed decisions and measure the success of their marketing and branding
efforts.

## Client-Centric Approach

At Meaningful Connections Brand Consulting, we prioritize our clients' success. Our client-centric
approach ensures that we always put our clients' needs first. We take the time to understand their
goals, challenges, and aspirations, allowing us to deliver customized solutions that drive
measurable results. We value long-term partnerships and strive to exceed our clients' expectations
at every step of the journey.

## Contact Us Today

Ready to take your business to new heights? Contact Meaningful Connections Brand Consulting today
and let our team of experts help you connect meaningfully with your target audience. With our
comprehensive consulting and analytical services, we'll guide you towards sustainable growth and
success in the business and consumer services industry.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does MetaSource do?

MetaSource delivers document management and business process automation services that combine
intelligent document processing, workflow automation, secure cloud platforms, and expert services to
help regulated organizations reduce manual work, strengthen compliance, and scale operations safely.

We provide a range of services and solutions to organizations in the mortgage, government,
healthcare, insurance, financial services, and manufacturing industries, including:
* Business process outsourcing (BPO) services
* Document scanning
* Digital mailroom outsourcing
* Workflow automation
* Mortgage quality control auditing
* Lockbox services alternative
* Document management
* Customer onboarding
* Loan boarding
* Accounts payable automation

### What business process or documentation problems do you help solve?

MetaSource helps organizations reduce manual document handling, eliminate processing backlogs,
improve accuracy and audit readiness, shorten cycle times, and achieve measurable operational ROI.
Our solutions are configured to every client’s unique needs and span AI-enabled technology, human
expertise, and services like digital mailroom and document scanning.

### Who can benefit from MetaSource’s business process automation services?

MetaSource’s services are designed for operations, compliance, and IT leaders in regulated,
document-heavy organizations who are responsible for reducing manual work, managing risk, and
improving efficiency. This includes but is not limited to:
* Directors and VPs of operations
* Compliance and risk leaders
* IT and system owners supporting document-driven workflows
* Finance leaders
* Directors and VPs of HR

Organizations in industries such as mortgage, financial services, healthcare, government, insurance,
and manufacturing particularly benefit from our solutions.

### What platforms or software systems do you offer?

MetaSource software offerings include our own proprietary solutions designed for document
management, workflow automation, and AP automation, as well as OpenText, Tungsten Automation
(formerly Kofax), and FileBound products. As a leading digital transformation solutions provider
with over 30 years of experience, our proprietary software is built to make your job easier. And as
a trusted partner to OpenText, Tungsten Automation, and FileBound, we have the expertise required to
support you from implementation through management.

## NAPS2 - Not Another PDF Scanner

NAPS2 stands as cost-free and open-source scanning software compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux
operating systems.

Effortlessly scan documents using devices such as Canon, Brother, HP, Epson, Fujitsu, and others.
Instantly save your scans in PDF, TIFF, JPEG, or PNG formats with just a single click.
[ Download Now ][14]

### Scan documents to PDF and more, as simply as possible.

## Optimize your scanner's performance by employing top-notch drivers.

Choose between WIA and TWAIN drivers, whichever works better for your scanner. Also choose settings
like DPI, page size, and bit depth. Scan from a flatbed or automatic document feeder (ADF),
including duplex support.

## Manipulate, trim, and reorganize images.

Reorder your pages effortlessly through drag-and-drop functionality. Arrange pages as needed for
manual duplex scanning. Rotate pages manually or automatically correct skewness to achieve the
proper angle. Utilize image editing tools to crop, adjust brightness, and enhance contrast as
required.

## Identify text using OCR

Explore the content within your PDFs by employing optical character recognition (OCR) in a multitude
of languages, exceeding 100 in total.

## Use NAPS2 in your native language

Choose from over 40 different languages. If your language isn’t available yet

## Batch scan

Use advanced batch scanning functionality to automate tedious scanning tasks. Combine multiple scans
together and automatically number and timestamp files.

## Tools for power users and businesses

Optional command-line interface (CLI) for automation and scripting NAPS2.Sdk scanning library for
.NET developers MSI installer and application-level configuration available for group policy (GPO)
deployment Portable archives available (doesn’t require installation)

## Free and open source

NAPS2 is completely free to use for both individuals and businesses, and includes no ads or unwanted
software. If NAPS2 has helped you, consider making a donation.

KNOW THIS FIRST

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NAPS2?

NAPS2, short for Not Another PDF Scanner 2, is a free and open-source software designed for scanning
documents into PDF and other formats. It provides a straightforward solution for users looking to
digitize physical documents.

How does NAPS2 differ from other PDF scanners?

NAPS2 stands out with its simplicity and efficiency. It offers a user-friendly interface, supports a
variety of scanners, and is known for its robust features while being open-source, making it a
cost-effective choice.

Is NAPS2 suitable for both personal and professional use?

Yes, NAPS2 is versatile and suitable for both personal and professional use. Whether you need to
digitize personal documents or manage paperwork in a professional setting, NAPS2 provides a reliable
solution.

Can I use NAPS2 with different types of scanners?

Absolutely. NAPS2 is compatible with a wide range of scanners, making it adaptable to various
hardware setups. Users can seamlessly integrate their preferred scanners with NAPS2 for efficient
document scanning.

What operating systems does NAPS2 support?

NAPS2 is compatible with Windows operating systems, providing a convenient solution for users on
Windows platforms.

Does NAPS2 offer any advanced scanning features?

Yes, NAPS2 includes advanced scanning features such as duplex scanning, color modes, and resolution
adjustments. These features enhance the scanning capabilities, making it a versatile tool for
different scanning needs.

Is NAPS2 free to use?

Yes, NAPS2 is open-source and free to use. Users can download and use the software without incurring
any costs, making it an accessible option for anyone looking for efficient document scanning.

How user-friendly is the NAPS2 interface?

NAPS2 is designed with a user-friendly interface, making it easy for both novice and experienced
users. The intuitive layout ensures a smooth scanning experience, with clear options for
customization.

Can NAPS2 handle OCR (Optical Character Recognition)?

Yes, NAPS2 supports OCR functionality, allowing users to convert scanned documents into editable
text. This feature adds value by making scanned content searchable and editable.

Are there any security features in NAPS2 to protect scanned documents?

While NAPS2 primarily focuses on scanning functionality, it is recommended to rely on additional
security measures for document protection. Users should implement secure document management
practices to ensure the confidentiality of scanned content.

# 3D Laser scanning · BIM Coordination · virtual construction · digital delivery & implementation

## Bespoke digital delivery for the AEC industry.

OAR provides 3D Laser Scanning, BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction, and Digital Delivery &
Implementation for teams that need verified data and coordinated models to build from.

[ Explore Our Services ][9]
[ Send Us a Message ][10]
Our approach

## Laser scanning is our foundation. What we do with the data is what sets us apart.

We don’t hand over deliverables and walk away. Every service OAR provides runs on the same
principle: your data should change something in the field. We understand the why behind the scan,
and we stay with your project and use the data to drive better outcomes.

01

### Reduce project risk

Verified spatial data eliminates costly field conflicts before they happen. Our coordination catches
clashes when they’re still lines on a screen.

02

### Accelerate delivery

Model-driven workflows compress review cycles and keep trades coordinated. Fewer RFIs, faster
approvals, fewer surprises at turnover.

03

### Make the data actionable

From a single scan to a full digital twin, we translate raw capture into insights your operations
team can act on.

04

### Full-chain accountability

We manage the entire workflow. Hardware, software, coordination, and delivery. Your team doesn’t
have to figure it out alone.

What we do

## Three services. One partner.

Our three services connect into one integrated workflow.

[1 2][1 2]

### Capture what's actually there.

Our 3D Laser Scanning service mobilizes to your site and captures exact as-built conditions using
high-accuracy laser scanners. The result is a verified point cloud your engineers, architects, and
contractors can build from. No assumptions. No outdated drawings.

### Reality capture, built around what you do next.

From industrial MRFs to multi-story commercial projects, our 3D Laser Scanning workflow starts with
one question: what does your team need to do with this data? We deliver point clouds, Revit models,
2D documentation, and as-built packages. One integrated workflow.
[ Explore 3D Laser Scanning → ][11]
[2 2][2 2]

### Coordinate before you build.

Our BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction service builds and coordinates multi-trade BIM models
from point cloud data or design drawings. Every spatial conflict is identified and resolved before
fabrication begins.

### Clash-free models. Construction-ready outcomes.

BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction at OAR covers the full process: BEP development, Revit model
build, clash detection across all trades, coordination meetings and construction verification and
installation support. Or we step into your existing BIM environment and handle targeted clash
resolution. .
[ Explore BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction → ][12]
[3 2][3 2]

### From data to decisions.

Our Digital Delivery & Implementation service connects data environments, builds digital twins, and
structures closeout packages. We consult to develop, train, and deploy cutting-edge, high impact
construction technology for our clients that they can use moving forward.

### Data that outlasts the project.

Digital Delivery & Implementation is about making your project data work after close-out. How do you
extract real value from digital deliverables? How do you tailor them to your client's needs, your
industry, your project type? Or how do you ensure that your capabilities stack up with other
advanced project partners? OAR is your resource to develop digital delivery and virtual construction
practices.
[ Explore Digital Delivery & Implementation → ][13]

# 3D Laser scanning · BIM Coordination · virtual construction · digital delivery & implementation

## Bespoke digital delivery for the AEC industry.

OAR provides 3D Laser Scanning, BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction, and Digital Delivery &
Implementation for teams that need verified data and coordinated models to build from.

[ Explore Our Services ][9]
[ Send Us a Message ][10]
Our approach

## Laser scanning is our foundation. What we do with the data is what sets us apart.

We don’t hand over deliverables and walk away. Every service OAR provides runs on the same
principle: your data should change something in the field. We understand the why behind the scan,
and we stay with your project and use the data to drive better outcomes.

01

### Reduce project risk

Verified spatial data eliminates costly field conflicts before they happen. Our coordination catches
clashes when they’re still lines on a screen.

02

### Accelerate delivery

Model-driven workflows compress review cycles and keep trades coordinated. Fewer RFIs, faster
approvals, fewer surprises at turnover.

03

### Make the data actionable

From a single scan to a full digital twin, we translate raw capture into insights your operations
team can act on.

04

### Full-chain accountability

We manage the entire workflow. Hardware, software, coordination, and delivery. Your team doesn’t
have to figure it out alone.

What we do

## Three services. One partner.

Our three services connect into one integrated workflow.

[1 2][1 2]

### Capture what's actually there.

Our 3D Laser Scanning service mobilizes to your site and captures exact as-built conditions using
high-accuracy laser scanners. The result is a verified point cloud your engineers, architects, and
contractors can build from. No assumptions. No outdated drawings.

### Reality capture, built around what you do next.

From industrial MRFs to multi-story commercial projects, our 3D Laser Scanning workflow starts with
one question: what does your team need to do with this data? We deliver point clouds, Revit models,
2D documentation, and as-built packages. One integrated workflow.
[ Explore 3D Laser Scanning → ][11]
[2 2][2 2]

### Coordinate before you build.

Our BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction service builds and coordinates multi-trade BIM models
from point cloud data or design drawings. Every spatial conflict is identified and resolved before
fabrication begins.

### Clash-free models. Construction-ready outcomes.

BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction at OAR covers the full process: BEP development, Revit model
build, clash detection across all trades, coordination meetings and construction verification and
installation support. Or we step into your existing BIM environment and handle targeted clash
resolution. .
[ Explore BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction → ][12]
[3 2][3 2]

### From data to decisions.

Our Digital Delivery & Implementation service connects data environments, builds digital twins, and
structures closeout packages. We consult to develop, train, and deploy cutting-edge, high impact
construction technology for our clients that they can use moving forward.

### Data that outlasts the project.

Digital Delivery & Implementation is about making your project data work after close-out. How do you
extract real value from digital deliverables? How do you tailor them to your client's needs, your
industry, your project type? Or how do you ensure that your capabilities stack up with other
advanced project partners? OAR is your resource to develop digital delivery and virtual construction
practices.
[ Explore Digital Delivery & Implementation → ][13]

## Consular Services

Essential services available at Philippine embassies and consulates

##### Passport Renewal

Renew or apply for a Philippine ePassport at any embassy or consulate. 10-year validity for adults,
5-year for minors. Online appointment booking available.

##### Visa Services

Apply for tourist, business, work, or immigrant visas to the Philippines. Check visa-free entry for
157 countries and territories with stays up to 30 days.

##### OFW Assistance

Support for Overseas Filipino Workers through POLO, OWWA, and DMW. Contract verification, labor
dispute resolution, welfare assistance, and repatriation services.

##### Dual Citizenship

Apply under RA 9225 to retain or reacquire Philippine citizenship. Own property, vote, and travel on
a Philippine passport while keeping your foreign nationality.

##### Document Authentication

Authenticate, apostille, or verify Philippine and foreign documents. Required for legal, employment,
and immigration purposes. Red ribbon and DFA authentication services.

##### Emergency Help

24/7 emergency consular assistance. DFA hotline: +63-2-8834-4000. Assistance-to-Nationals (ATN) for
distressed Filipinos, medical emergencies, and repatriation.
